istanbul_geonames_745044.name: Istanbul
istanbul_geonames_745044.reviewEvidence: GeoNames identifies a P/PPLA populated city in TR and gives this numeric reference point; its hierarchy distinguishes the city feature from the administrative feature. istanbul_geonames_745044.limit: City reference only. Exact observer and object positions within or around the reported city are not supplied; no city-boundary centroid or exact observation position is inferred.

mojave_faa_mhv.name: Mojave Airport / Mojave Air and Space Port
mojave_faa_mhv.reviewEvidence: FAA Airport Master Record fields19 and20 publish the airport latitude/longitude and label latitude estimated. FAA airport diagram identifies MHV at Mojave, California. The account explicitly names KMHV and the airport aircraft boneyard; KEDW is departure context.
mojave_faa_mhv.limit: Airport reference marker only. It does not locate the photographer within the boneyard or the photographed object. The airport coordinate is estimated and must not be labeled a measured observation point.
